description: HELD-DUP (critic round 1). Saved position from critic game s7412: round 1, Player 1 Movement, after the Prosecutor Squad moved onto the ruin that hosts obj_home_1. The AI measured control only within 3.79 in of the marker, read obj_home_1 as uncontrolled and sent Custodian Guard Beta 9 in back to 'capture' it (rollout value check: the reviewer's alternative was +2.9 VP [1.3, 4.5] over 36 seeds). The game scores any model on the hosting terrain area (11e 14.01). The scenario opens Suggest (K) twice on the same position: first with FIX_HELD_DUP=0 (the old reading: Beta is sent to capture obj_home_1), then with the fix on (obj_home_1 is read as held; Beta goes forward). Nothing is executed.

steps.comment: BEFORE: switch the fix off for P1

MERGE: fix off no longer reproduces the reviewed mistake — main's terrain-aware objective range (OBJ-GAP-1/2, the live board's hosting area) is now the base read, so obj_home_1 is held even with FIX_HELD_DUP = 0

steps.script: return tree.root.get_node("Main")._ai_suggestion_panel.full_text.contains("Custodian Guard Sodality Beta (OC3): ") and not tree.root.get_node("Main")._ai_suggestion_panel.full_text.contains("Custodian Guard Sodality Beta (OC3): MOVE obj_home_1")
steps.comment: MERGE: Beta is in the movement plan and not sent back to obj_home_1. With main's nearest-model gaps Alpha now takes obj_center (and heads the card) and Beta obj_nml_1, so the card's own decision may be Alpha's
